Question 13(a) [2 marks]: Outline how operations and ONE other key business function are interdependent.

MARKING CRITERIA (out of 2):
2 marks: Sketches in general terms how operations are interdependent with another business function
1 marks: Provides relevant information

SAMPLE ANSWER (official):
Operations and marketing are interdependent because operations must produce goods that match the features and quality promised by marketing. In turn, marketing relies on operations to deliver products on time and at the right standard and quality, and with the right features, so customer needs are met, which supports sales and customer satisfaction.

ANSWERS COULD INCLUDE (the student does not need every point):
HR and Finance are also acceptable. Show the dependence in BOTH directions.
